name: game-studios-delivery
description: 用轻量 Quick Design 与故事完成门禁，推动游戏小改动可验收交付；完整工作室方法论参考 Claude-Code-Game-Studios。

profession.zh: 轻量游戏设计与故事完成检查

displayDescription.zh: 对调参、小机制与短周期功能做 Quick Design Spec，并按故事完成门禁验收；过大改动会引导回到完整系统设计。
displayDescription.en: Produces Quick Design Specs for tuning, small mechanics, and short features, with story-done gates; redirects oversized changes to full system design.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请说明游戏改动目标、现有系统、引擎/仓库约束与验收标准。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Describe the change goal, existing systems, engine/repo constraints, and acceptance criteria.

quickPrompts.zh: 为这次小改动写一份 Quick Design Spec
quickPrompts.en: Write a Quick Design Spec for this small change

quickPrompts.zh: 检查当前故事是否达到 story-done 门禁
quickPrompts.en: Check whether the current story meets the story-done gate

quickPrompts.zh: 判断这次改动该走轻量规格还是完整系统设计
quickPrompts.en: Decide whether this change needs a quick spec or full system design
